response.text:
Journal 1368 has debits of 9,890.12 and credits of 9,872.12, so it is out of balance by 18.00. The finding says the AP credit and the expense debit should match, but it does not say which side holds the typo. The invoice amount (INV_AMT) isn't visible to me, so I can't confirm which side is correct.

The summary says "expense debit does not equal AP credit". Without the invoice amount, the smallest fix that balances the group is a one-sided line. The 18.00 difference looks like a keying error on the AP credit (9872.12 against 9890.12), which is a digit transposition (87 vs 89). A credit of 18.00 to 2000 brings AP Control to 9,890.12, matching the expense debit.

The correction goes in period 11, the earliest open period, and uses a single credit line of 18.00 to account 2000. No invoice status changes, since this is not a duplicate_invoice finding.
